item.title: GitHub Copilot model selection and policy controls arrive across supported IDE experiences
item.description: Developers can select approved models directly in their editor.
item.content:encoded:
Developers can select approved models directly in their editor while organizations control availability, plans, policies, preview access, and provider choices across several supported environments.

Teams can use the controls to standardize everyday coding tasks without reviewing every model, configuration option, rollout phase, and administrative setting in the release documentation.

The complete source also describes experimental options, individual IDE versions, policy prerequisites, navigation steps, and additional examples for administrators.
